note: One isometric figure per physical thing in the fleet, generated from the committed CAD. Every surface — glass, wrist, phone, web, emulator — draws from this ledger, so they cannot show a user two different pictures of one object. Hand edits are overwritten; run the generator.

projector.frame: +X right, +Y front (toward the viewer), +Z up; millimeters
projector.camera: fixed at (+X,+Y,+Z) for every figure in the fleet

ladder.shipping: committed STLs + a firmware config + a released catalog variant

ladder.prototype: in development — not committed to print
ladder.idea: a research note and a sketch; renders as a ghost, never as a product
ladder.derived: from evidence on disk, never hand-typed — see each figure's `evidence`
